decision: expo install reanimated+worklets (4.5.1 / 0.10.1); npm i exact react-native-webgpu@0.5.17 react-native-audio-api@0.13.6; add @webgpu/types@0.1.65 devDep; tsconfig types=[@webgpu/types]; NO babel.config.js
why: babel-preset-expo (node_modules/expo/node_modules/babel-preset-expo/build/configs/expo.js:96) auto-adds react-native-worklets/plugin when installed; reanimated/plugin re-exports worklets/plugin. @webgpu/types is only a devDependency of react-native-webgpu so GPUBufferUsage etc. were untyped without it
evidence: tsc --noEmit clean; Metro bundled index.ts 1160 modules with no babel config

decision: run:ios: --udid is not a flag; use --device <udid>
why: expo run:ios rejects --udid (CommandError: Unknown arguments: --udid); help lists -d/--device
evidence: npx expo run:ios --help; retry with --device succeeded
result: fixed (CLI flag, not a build failure)

decision: failure 1 (runtime, native build itself succeeded): iOS 27 app aborts at launch 'UIScene life cycle is required for apps built with this SDK'. Fix: local config plugin plugins/with-ios-scene-delegate.js adds UIApplicationSceneManifest, SceneDelegate.swift (ExpoAppSceneDelegate subclass), makes AppDelegate conform to ExpoReactNativeFactoryProvider and drops window creation, mirroring the SDK 58 template
why: Xcode 27.1 / iOS 27 SDK; expo 57.0.27 ships ExpoAppSceneDelegate in node_modules/expo/ios/AppDelegates but the SDK 57 prebuild template does not use it; ios/ is gitignored so the fix must live in a prebuild plugin to survive --clean; compared against expo-template-bare-minimum@58.0.16
evidence: after prebuild --clean + rebuild: app launches, Metro bundles, triangle renders
